core_rules: Ledger is source/planning memory, not canonical Plans.
Use Plan Wizard terminology only in new content.
Owner ambiguity is adjudicated by the agent using evidence; do not ask row-by-row.
Do not run PlanCompile or build WorkNodes from this ledger.
Preserve exact tokens, examples, negative constraints, stale/compat notes, owner hints, and user corrections.
Compile accepted atoms into PlanUnits and owner docs, then audit before governance seal.
Use state/implementation_readiness_matrix.json to ensure PlanUnits are implementation-ready, with exact fields, schemas, acceptance criteria, validators, and boundaries.
Use state/doc_impact_matrix.json to update direct owner/consumer/reference docs or record no-update/deferred evidence after reference scans.
